what_it_does: Proposes a data exchange framework leveraging Smart Network Interface Cards (SmartNICs—specialized network cards that can perform computation independently from the main CPU). In high-performance computing clusters, gathering data from distributed nodes for analysis is common but consumes CPU resources. This framework offloads data exchange operations to SmartNICs, reducing system load. Characterizes performance improvements in latency, throughput, and scalability on real HPC hardware with different configurations.
